description: List all 71 available programming languages and their IDs for code execution. Common IDs: 71=Python 3.8, 63=JavaScript (Node.js), 62=Java, 54=C++ (GCC), 60=Go, 73=Rust, 51=C#, 46=Bash. Returns full list with compiler/interpreter versions (Judge0 CE)

filter.description: Optional filter — substring match on language name (e.g. "python", "java", "rust"). Returns all 71 languages if omitted

name: dev.code.languages

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: List Programming Languages
